summary: Ameren Corp and co-registrant Union Electric (Ameren Missouri) filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 disclosing that Ameren Missouri submitted its non-binding 2026 Integrated Resource Plan to the Missouri Public Service Commission on September 28, 2026. The preferred plan forecasts load growth of roughly 2.9-3.9 GW by 2030, 5-6 GW by 2035 and 6-9 GW by 2045, funded through gas, solar, wind, battery storage and new nuclear additions while retiring coal and some gas. No transaction, security, or special-situation event is present; watch for MoPSC review and future cost-recovery filings.
